messages:
maria: Handoff — I'm out in ~15. Quick watchlist & actions for the next shift:
- prefix-cache: intermittent key miss spikes in eu region (seen since 03:40UTC). Symptoms: higher tail latency for short requests, increased retries. Probable cause: cache evictions due to an unexpected TTL churn. Current mitigation: reduced eviction aggressiveness (config changed by infra at 04:05). Watch for >3% miss rate over 5m and increased retried reqs.
- encoder-pool: one node in encoder-pool-3 is flapping (OOM-ish restarts). Autoscaler hasn't replaced it cleanly; pods cycle ~every 8–12m. Workaround: cordon then drain that node; a remediation PR is in staging (PR #4821) but not deployed.
- telemetry-sampler: sampling rate dropped to 20% (expected 50%) intermittently, causing sparse traces for some flows. A scheduled config roll happened earlier; rollbacks possible if tracing gaps worsen.
- noisy-alert: kv-prefetch alert triggers on short-lived latency spikes. It's noisy but not service-impacting. If it starts staying >5m escalate.
- model-swap-fallback: rare fallback to smaller model during burst — observed twice yesterday. This is safe but increases token latency by ~40ms.

Actions for you:
1) If prefix-cache miss rate >3% for 3 consecutive windows, escalate to infra (cc @akshay) and flip eviction flag back to previous value: kubectl apply -f /deploy/cfg/prefix-cache-evict.yaml
2) For encoder flapping: cordon node encoder-node-17 and let autoscaler replace. Command quick:
```
kubectl cordon encoder-node-17
kubectl drain encoder-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
3) Telemetry: check tracing dashboard (Console -> Observability -> Traces); if sampling <30% for >15m open a ticket and consider rollback.
4) Ignore the kv-prefetch noise for now unless alert persists >5m and impacts p95.

If you need runbooks:
- prefix-cache: /runbooks/prefix-cache-ttl.md
- encoder-pool: /runbooks/encoder-pool-flap.md
- telemetry: /runbooks/telemetry-sampler.md

Thanks — leaving @akshay as primary for infra escalations, @samir covers EU overnight.

akshay: ack. I'll keep an eye on encoder node. If it flaps again I'll cordon and file a support request with provider. Also will roll back prefix-cache eviction if we see sustained 3%+ misses.

leo: noted. I can deploy PR #4821 to staging tonight and run the heal script. @maria can you paste the staging job name? I didn't catch it.

maria: leo — staging job is inference-redeploy-2026-11-03 (ran at 04:12). It currently reports ok but not fully exercised. If you deploy, run `scripts/heal_encoder.sh --force` after rollout.

samir: I'm on EU night cover. I'll monitor prefix-cache dashboards and run the cordon if needed. ping me if the kv-prefetch alert flips to red.

julie: quick Q — does the model-swap fallback have an automated rollback? If latency spike hits 99th, do we need manual intervention?

maria: julie — no automated rollback. Fallback is a soft routing policy; if you see sustained higher p99 (>500ms) for 10m, switch routing policy to prefer primary slot: `rbacctl set-route --model primary --force` (only infra can run in prod, so page akshay).

oncall-bot: Deploy bot: inference-redeploy-2026-11-03 completed by ci-bot at 04:12 UTC :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks all. Leaving notes in the handoff doc too: /handovers/2026-11-03-maria.json :wave:
